Extended the stacking fix to selected-spell melee-trigger effects (Mark of Faith, True Shot, Thunderous Mark, Stormy Coat, Frenzy); Frenzy's resist changed from Agility to (less-resistible) Normal Weapons; new spec-locked armor's Weakness To raised 10->40 to account for resists; Mark of Faith duration raised to 60s.

New Tailoring recipes added to the Crafters Consortium; Consortium-obtained recipes are now [No Trade] for now. Added Fashionista Bonnie in Pelagiad, a Tailoring daily-supply-quest NPC granting gold, mastery XP, and Crafters Marks.

Teased the Tomb of the Desiccator, a new dungeon/camp. Added Grandmaster Crafters Marks (1 per tradeskill per week from completing all three tier-10 tradeskill dailies). Added new Jewelry recipes to the Crafters Consortium, plus a UI cleanup.
stated_values: 1 Grandmaster Crafters Mark per tradeskill per week

updates.gist: Added /timer for viewing time until daily/weekly resets. Login Points now cap at 10,000 (existing overflow retained, not reduced). Deployed a patch attempting to fix werewolf damage failing outside cell authority.
Werewolves with Controlled Regression can now double-tap sneak in beast form to instantly revert, toggled via /togglesneakrevert or /wwsneakrevert.
Elder MCA Tribal Ward reworked into a 15-minute group ward that heals affected members for +350 (+50% Willpower mod) over 4s when they're physically struck.
stated_values: Tribal Ward heals +350 (+50% Willpower mod) for 4s

updates.gist: Major fix to how attack bonus (hit chance), defend bonus (dodge chance), cast penalty (cast chance), and armor bonus interact with certain equipment and abilities.
Vampire Daywalker's Weakness to Fire/Magicka cut to 10 each (from 25/50); Ancient Bloodline's cut to 20 each (from 50/100).
Added new birthsign-locked CMs (level 51, matching birthsign required, cost 120 CM points each).
stated_values: Birthsign-51 CMs cost 120 points, require level 51

updates.gist: Introduced the Endowment System via Enchantress Tessarina: after unlocking it, players can store one constant-effect enchanted Robe and one Skirt with her, and their enchant effects apply passively without wearing the items, toggleable via /endow — effects persist through werewolf transformation.
Added Rehabilitator Anja (near the Vivec bank), who refunds Class Mastery points for a gold fee scaling with level — 50,000g at level 15, up to 500,000g at level 55.
Added a new creature camp: Murk Dreugh in a mostly-underwater cave, guarded by a Warlord boss (requires water breathing and melee).

Added class/level restrictions to some Murk Dreugh loot table items, increased overall drop chances, and buffed the Warlord boss. Ring of Ages renamed Ring of Ageas and reworked; Murk Claw Ring reworked.
Player Training now resets daily instead of on an exact 24-hour timer.

Pilfering Potential now also grants Pilfering Stash (Feather scaling with lockpick tier while a lockpick is equipped); Shadowstalker now adds +30 to +150% critical strike damage per rank (bugged for ranged). Burglar MC and Quick Hands grant extra Pilfering Stash ranks. Metabolist MC/Miraculous Mix/Immunity now passively boost freshly-mixed potion potency, duration, and count (with both MCAs, +1 extra potion count).

Gypsy Were-Hunter Stake now stacks damage correctly; Assassin MC +35%, Bravo/Hunter MC +20% passive critical strike damage; Soldier/Guardian/Defender/Death Knight gain improved block chance and reduced block fatigue cost; Thunderous Mark recast cut 180->15s.

Juggernaut's Crush recast cut 150->60s; Berserker/Reckless Vigor made attacks more cumbersome to execute; Gypsy Khajiit's Seasoned Traveler gains passive +75 Feather; Burglar MC gains passive +50 Feather; Soldier MC/Mercenary Redguard MC attacks no longer drain fatigue.
Sorcerer's elemental Fingers MCAs and Channeler's Mana Blast now additionally apply a 200% elemental/magicka weakness (ignoring the normal weakness resist limit) for 30s on the target.
stated_values: 200% weakness effect that ignores the weakness resist cap

updates.gist: Forester's Feral Companion MCA replaced with a reworked Flame Lick (775 +125% Agility fire damage on touch every 36s, 291 fatigue cost). Breathy Ballad duration increased from 60/180/360s to 1800/3600/5400s.
stated_values: Flame Lick: 775 (+125% Agility) fire damage, 36s cooldown, 291 fatigue cost

updates.gist: Mass Health Factor squish across many CM/MC lines (Blessing of Nirn, Plaguebearer's Rune, Orcish Brute, Hearty, Reckless Vigor, Bravo, Chosen, Guardian, Metabolist, Soldier, Soldier's Cry, Cursed Orc all reduced); Assassin's Skill/Poisoned Blade now require short blades specifically instead of any bladed weapon. Added new CM lines Anthemic Crescendo (Bard), Purifying Touch (Monk), Quick Blade (Ranger), Rakish Attack (Rogue). Mandatory full CM refund, free for 7 days.
stated_values: Example: Blessing of Nirn Health Factor 1 -> 0.2

updates.gist: Added new CM lines with attached Health Factors: Arcane Fortitude (Caster, Endurance), Battle Instincts (Stealth, Agility), Battle Hardened (Combat, Endurance), Battle Tested (Combat, Strength).

Overhauled many "when this is your selected spell" CM triggers to cost specific Fatigue/Magicka amounts rather than simply draining them. Glorious Cry/Hero's Shout/Dark Touch now trigger on melee attacks; True Shot and Jolt now require being the selected spell to trigger on bow shots (True Shot damage mod raised 200->300%, both got new/shortened cooldowns); Infernal Bond's stat mod and duration increased; Banshee Wail heavily reworked and buffed; the Mug line triggers on melee; Life Clutch magnitudes raised; the Primal Scream line reworked with longer duration/radius and new magicka costs. Tenacious Frost Giant glyph/shield drop rates lowered.

Vampire Feed and Vampiric Strike CMs now trigger on melee attacks while selected (Feed: 400 unresistible damage, 70% chance for 1 Blood every 3s; Vampiric Strike: 1200-1500 unresistible damage every 12s scaled by level); Frenzy also now triggers on melee.
stated_values: Feed: 400 unresistible dmg, 70% chance/3s for 1 Blood

updates.gist: Smite Undead line reworked so its damage now applies on every physical attack for a 10-minute window instead of a single instance.

Quick Hands and Power Ballad MCAs now also trigger on physical melee attacks (not just on cast); raised the max achievable combo damage; added new general CMs Combo Focus 1-3 (combos no longer break on taking damage; double devastating-effect chance; triple combo damage), unlockable from level 15/35/55.

Bosmer racial Naturekin reworked into a passive renamed Nature's Kin; Breton racial Seer fixed to be properly toggleable. Set the Always Succeeds cast-chance flag on various CMs. Experimentally added specialization cast/dodge/attack chance penalties: Combat (small cast, major dodge penalty), Stealth (small attack, major cast penalty), Magic (small dodge, major attack penalty).
Werewolf beast forms (Beast/Feral Beast/Dire Beast) now fortify Agility instead of Endurance, to avoid killing players via extreme endurance loss on /revert.
Added Cosmetologist Galwen in Vivec's St. Delyn Plaza, who alters a character's face/hair appearance for a gold fee.

Added a one-time Race/Class/Birthsign respec at level 60 via Socucius Ergalla in Seyda Neen (requires the Death of a Taxman quest be either completed or not yet started, no spent mastery points, and not being in beast form); the server's 2-year anniversary event grants an extra respec via an Anniversary Certificate.

Long-term Patreon supporters (12+ months at Tier 5 equivalent, with lower-tier equivalents also unlockable) can trigger or extend Happy Hour once every 72 hours via /activatehappyhour, account-bound and experimental.

Flora is now visually harvestable for all players regardless of graphic herbalism settings; cell resets no longer guarantee ingredient respawn, and players are advised to disable graphic herbalism in owned homes to avoid permanently-picked plants.

Launched Player Housing: purchase personalized homes from Bim Joonie (gold cost, level/playtime/quest gates), pay 10% of original cost as biweekly upkeep, demolish/restore vanilla furniture, place crafted/owned furniture with no-collision mode, control public/private access and visitor allow/deny lists, assign co-owners, run Shopkeeper Mode with a secure deposit box and transaction logs, and configure activation behavior (access restriction, teleport points, sounds, messages, exit warps) via Object Settings. Added the Furnisher tradeskill (150+ craftable furnishings via workbench, some modular) and new Crafters Consortium furnishing recipes.
stated_values: Home upkeep: 10% of original purchase price every 2 weeks
updates.era_note: Launch of Player Housing — a major new game system (purchasable homes, the Furnisher tradeskill, shopkeeping) built out over dozens of follow-up patches.

updates.gist: Free CM refund week. Guardian MC's Armor Bonus raised 500->550; Guardian's Aura replaced with Divinity (+20 all-element/magicka resist, +350 HP, +100 Armor); Guardian's Relentlessness replaced with Guardian's Aid (group HoT + passive Restoration Max/Armor Bonus). Added three new Master Classes: Crusader (Combat, undead-slaying heal proc), Ninja (Stealth, Vanish invisibility power, elemental Ninjutsu proc), and Animator (Magic, Grand Animation summon that doesn't count toward the summon limit, plus Rune of Animation damage proc). Animation Adept now grants a unique summon per rank.
Player-made potion magnitudes/durations rebalanced for cross-race parity; Reflect and Spell Absorption potions had their magnitudes greatly reduced.
Dismiss Summon is now also obtainable as a free (0 CM) power starting at level 6, an instant-recast alternative to /dismisssummon that doesn't count toward the summon limit.
Players can now access their backpack and loot cache contents inside any player home; homeowners/co-owners can restrict item add/remove permissions on containers for allowed visitors.

Introduced Chain Casting: Magic-spec players who cast a damage spell within 9 seconds of a matching-element Special Combo Attack (their own or a group member's) unleash an AOE amplified version of that combo attack, scaled by the caster's initial damage and Destruction skill; toggleable display via /chain.
stated_values: Chain Cast window: 9 seconds after a matching Special Combo Attack

updates.gist: Players can now only wait/rest by using a bed.
Fixed a vanilla Morrowind exploit allowing players to create Corprus-inflicting spells; existing player-made Corprus spells had the component stripped (or the spell removed if it was Corprus-only).
Trees now have a small chance to produce resin when chopped.
The Crafters Consortium now exchanges Essences for high-tier jewelry, costing 1 essence and 1 Grand Mark per exchange.
Added /passwordchange, letting players change their account password in-game (special characters discouraged due to bugs).
Necromancer line Teachings of Arkay had its buff duration/recast lowered from 30 minutes to 15 minutes.
stated_values: Teachings of Arkay duration/recast: 30 min -> 15 min

updates.gist: Lower-tier Crafters Marks can now be upgraded to higher tiers at the Crafters Consortium.
The Rampage 51 CM can now be resisted to a small degree.
Hold Breath CM line now always succeeds; added a new jewelcrafting ring recipe at the Crafters Consortium.

Broad rebalance of all thirteen level-51 birthsign CMs, mostly cutting recast times significantly (e.g. Apprentice's Power Burst 510->420s, Mage's Call of the Mage 3600->1800s, Thief's Lucky Seven 420->7s) and some magnitude/duration tweaks (Atronach's Form of the Atronach now doubles returned magicka; Steed's Swift Wind now costs no magicka).
stated_values: Swift Wind: no longer costs magicka (was 412)

updates.gist: All CM summon lines had their health pools doubled with improved resilience; Teachings of Arkay significantly improved and lost its cooldown entirely; several elemental Atronach/Death summons now also cast matching Weakness+damage spells. Fixed a Soul Mastery cooldown bug.

Launched the Fishing system: a Fishing Guru in Khuul starts the questline, fishing poles are equippable, 2,000+ unique fish exist with varied weights/ingredient effects, regional fishing crates drop unique items, /fish gives info, two new bosses are catchable and distribute loot to all online participants, and new tradeskill recipes (fishing, jewelcrafting, tailoring) were added.
updates.era_note: Launch of the Fishing system — a major new content pillar (2,000+ fish, regional crates, catchable bosses, new tradeskill recipes) expanded across many follow-up patches.

updates.gist: The Fishing Guru now exchanges caught fish for Fishing Points, redeemable for rewards.
Fishing now requires moving to a different cell after enough casts in one spot; AFK fishing now results in a server kick after a timeout, to prevent cell desync issues from AFK players.
In-game chat is now bridged with the #in-game-chat Discord channel.
Disabled Survival Mode's warmth and wetness mechanics (may return later).

Fishing no longer requires a cell change once fish stop biting — just moving a short distance; moving farther grants a decaying fishing XP bonus of up to +35%. Fishing bosses were made slightly less trivial against certain effects.
stated_values: Max fishing XP boost from repositioning: +35%

updates.gist: Players can now move through non-hostile NPCs indoors by activating them while in spellcasting stance (not usable under Telekinesis).

Fish container storage capacity quadrupled; added a bait-container tradeskill recipe and consumable fishing-benefit potions to the Fishing Guru's rewards; fishing bosses now require active participation to award loot.

Added 3 new server-side quest chains (Strength, Wit, Speed trials via Goran the Strong, Inquiladius Expica, and Wria Lightningfoot) unlocking new class mastery lines on completion; initial quests open at level 20.

Blocking reworked: shields now block automatically without positioning as long as one is equipped; block chance range widened (iBlockMinChance 10->15, iBlockMaxChance 50->65) with a significant fatigue cost increase for successful blocks. Safeguard CM's block-chance passive removed (cell priority issues) but its block-fatigue-reduction passive was greatly improved; Melding Construct now scales Armor Rating with rank; exiting homes now applies a slowfall effect.
Melding Construct CM now also grants Armorer's Favor, a temporary skill fortification after repairing an item of that type.

Reintroduced Mannequins: place them in homes/vaults to display, equip-from, trade-with, or return equipment; 20 race/gender combos purchasable from Duharr via Login Points plus 30 more from other sources; mannequins don't count toward item placement limits and are restricted to the homeowner to prevent No Trade item exploits.
stated_values: 20 mannequin variants via Login Points + 30 from other methods

updates.gist: Homeowners/co-owners can now rename crafted, placed containers (200-character limit); a container must be reverted to its default name before it can be returned to inventory.
Added Dwemerologist Thadren, unlocking a new method of equipment advancement upon completing his questline.

Fixed the new equipment-upgrade system (likely the Infusion Anvil): item statistics no longer decrease during upgrades, and Enchant Value no longer increases on already-enchanted items — those items instead receive larger boosts to their other stats on successful upgrades.

/stuck now works like Exit Home indoors; the Equipment Upgrade system was scaled back to its originally intended power level. Iron Fist CM now adds 20-100% (per rank) of equipped gauntlet armor rating as non-resistible fist damage. Added three new Combat CM pairs: Rend/Slash (Warrior, AOE strike + Normal Weapon resist debuff), Cleave/Split (Paladin, AOE strike + resist debuff/silence), Rip/Sever (Shadowknight, AOE strike + resist debuff/Reflect nullify). Free CM refunds for a limited time.
stated_values: Iron Fist: 20/40/60/80/100% of gauntlet armor rating as bonus fist damage

updates.gist: Added a hidden-state toggle for individual Quick Hot Keys (/hk), the /quickkeypage (/qkp) command for instantly switching key pages, and up to 8 additional quick key pages / 16 additional hot keys purchasable with Reward Points.
stated_values: Up to +8 quick key pages, +16 quick hot keys via RP

updates.gist: Master Armorer trainer Sirollus Saccus relocated to the Hawkmoth Legion Garrison in Ebonheart; a new Master Medium Armor trainer, Cinia Urtius, added at Tel Fyr. Bigger Pockets' Feather effect raised to 15/rank (from 10); several armor-type CM lines (Iron Hearted, Energetic Fortitude, Resourceful Covering, Thick Skin) now grant scaling bonuses (Feather/Attack/Chameleon/Resist Magicka) based on a percentage of the wearer's total armor rating when in a full matching-type set.

Overhauled the Explosive Eureka CM line: thrown potions now cost 10% of Max Magicka from Current Magicka (fail silently if insufficient), and on hitting a foe deal tiered Poison Damage (Unstable 100, Explosive 260, Detonating 530, Meteoric 662, Kinetic 942, all +20% Willpower mod) if the thrower has enough magicka.
stated_values: Cast cost: 10% of Max Magicka per throw

updates.gist: Overhauled the Sorcerous Maelstrom CM line: each of its 5 tiers now deals a primary single-target elemental hit plus a secondary lower-damage AOE hit with an Intelligence modifier, with full new damage/cost values per tier. Also buffed several magic MCAs: Power Induction's Restore Magicka duration 1->30s, Arcane Shock/Mana Blast area 0->10ft, Sorcerer's Fingers damage 600->800 with a new 25ft weakness area, Lich Subversion's Willpower mod 10->50% (damage now resistible), Lich Form's restore/damage 33->66, Exorcise recast 42->3s, Mark of Faith duration 60->120s with heal proc 30->65, Call Lightning area 6->15ft with recast 9->3s, Thunderous Mark area 6->15ft with a new Weakness to Shock effect, Molten Silver area 0->15ft.
stated_values: Sorcerous Maelstrom 5: 764 primary + 326 (+60% Destruction) AOE fire/frost/shock, 339 magicka

updates.gist: Channeler's Bounty Fortify Magicka raised to 400/800/1200 (from 70/210/640); Stormy Coat's damage shield raised to 25/50/75/100; Deadly Covenant's Restore Health raised and Damage Health lowered with a longer damage duration.

CM refunds are no longer free, requiring Gold or a Rose of Renewal. Combo damage scaling changed so slower weapons deal more combo damage and faster weapons less. Fishing no longer requires periodic movement, and a general crashed-client-kick fix made the old anti-AFK fishing script unnecessary.

Introduced Enchantment Imprinting: Enchanters dismantle tradeskill gems at the Resource Salvager into Gem Dust (10 Gem Dust = 1 Enchant Value), condense Gem Dust into an unequippable dagger-type Shard of Enchanting at any Forge, enchant the Shard normally, then imprint it onto an unenchanted item of equal or greater Enchant Value and matching cast type via /imprint — consuming both items to produce the newly enchanted item. The current imprintable Enchant Value cap is 260 (2,600 Gem Dust).
stated_values: Imprintable Enchant Value cap: 260 (2,600 Gem Dust)

updates.gist: Overmaxed attributes/skills no longer show a misleading drain effect in the effects list; relogging now clears damage attribute/skill effects (but not blight/disease drains); /inspect now shows base attribute/skill values.

Boots/Helm of Blinding Speed no longer auto-transform by race; players can freely swap between racial variants at any armor crafting anvil under a new Unique Variants category (no tradeskill XP granted). /inspect now also shows overmaxed values.

Stalhrim nodes must now be physically struck with the Ancient Nordic Pick Axe instead of activated, yielding more Raw Stalhrim per node and respawning faster since they no longer wait on a full cell reset.
Fixed Stalhrim nodes not registering physical strikes due to collision issues; nodes now also have a small chance to yield Frost Salts.

Furnisher tradeskill gains Dwemer furniture (140+ new pieces) plus a new meshless lighting system with 100+ light-source profiles, some unlocked by exploration; added a Lighting Helper to the decorator menu for managing them.
stated_values: Over 140 new furnishings, 100+ light source profiles

updates.gist: Guild TLC update: guild list shows online/total member counts, kick permission bugs fixed. Guilds can now level up to 25, earning XP from kills, harvesting, tradeskill crafting, wood/stone/ore gathering, and fishing; each guild level grants 2.5 Guild Perk Points spendable by Masters/Elders on 5-tier perks (costing 1/2/2/3/4 points per tier): Guild Hauling (+5-25% chest gold), Guild Grinding (+2-10% Mastery XP), Guild Harvesting (+3-15% extra harvest chance), Guild Crafting (+2-10% Tradeskill/Fishing XP), Guild Treasure Hunting (+1-5% rare item odds). Perks refundable for 2,500g/point; /guildcontribution shows top contributors.
stated_values: +10 XP per slain enemy (up to 40 grouped), +1 XP per caught fish
Guild Perk Point cost per tier: 1/2/2/3/4
Perk refund cost: 2,500 gold per point

updates.gist: Added a new creature camp: Infernal Atronachs overrunning volcanic parts of Molag Amur, spread across multiple mini-camps with fast respawns and a chance for powerful item drops.
Corrected the new Infernal Atronachs' names and made them properly harvestable after being slain; fixed incorrect body-part slots on their new equipment drops.

Clarified macro policy: macros must not activate faster than a human could realistically replicate (sub-0.1s delays are bannable server-lag risks); private, low-traffic self-training via macro (e.g. Restoration/Alteration) is acceptable; AFK macroing at grind camps is not, since it desyncs the area for other players.

A server backup process ran out of storage space; the cleanup step deleted backups mid-condensation, losing roughly two weeks of backup history and corrupting at least one player's save (being manually restored). AWS storage will be expanded, though upgrading proved harder than expected, prompting a planned migration to an updated server.
Reiterated that exploiting server bugs — especially unfixable ones — will result in permanent removal from the server.
Asked players not to discuss methods of bypassing anti-cheat measures.
Announced a mandatory server host migration requiring the hosting device to be restarted, planned for a low-population window with downtime duration still unknown.
updates.era_note: Server host migration — one of the explicit major-event categories (the server moving hosts).
